# HouseKeeping
import pandas as pd
from notebookutils import mssparkutils
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 500, "display.width", 250)

ROOT    = "abfss://apmt-elz@navispowerbidatastorage2.dfs.core.windows.net/"
MH_DIR  = ROOT + "bronze/sandbox/moves_export/moves_export"                       # Move History exports (loads + yard moves)
PC_PATH = ROOT + "bronze/Rehandle_Moves_delta/rehandles"    # N4 position corrections (Delta)
OUT     = ROOT + "sandbox/hk_analysis/"

# corrections table: spec name -> your column
PC = dict(unit="container_nbr", event="event", frm="from_position",
          to="to_position", ts="time_of_event", status="status")

# event / value filters (compared in UPPER case)
YARD_EVENT, LOAD_EVENT, CORR_EVENT = "UNIT_YARD_MOVE", "UNIT_LOAD", "UNIT_POSITION_CORRECTION"
YARD_MOVE_KINDS = ["YARD"]
LOAD_MOVE_KINDS = ["LOAD"]
EXPORT_VALS     = ["EXPORT", "EXPRT"]
FCL_MH, FCL_PC  = "FCL", "FCL"          # Unit_Frght_Kind (MH) / status (corrections)

# position rules
STD = r"^Y-PEB-[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{3}\d{2}[A-Z]\d$"
PRESTAGE_BLOCKS = ["G229", "G231", "G329", "G429"]
PRESTAGE_PREFIX = ["RS", "RE", "RR"]

# time windows
DEDUP_MOVE  = pd.Timedelta("10min")
DEDUP_LOAD  = pd.Timedelta("2h")
LOAD_WINDOW = pd.Timedelta("2h")

# reporting
GO_LIVE        = pd.Timestamp("2026-09-28")   # W0 Monday
MIN_LOADS_WEEK = 100
EXCLUDE_DAYS   = []                            # set after the coverage check, e.g. ["2026-10-13"]

def is_prestage(s):
    return s.str[6:10].isin(PRESTAGE_BLOCKS) | s.str[6:8].isin(PRESTAGE_PREFIX)

import re

MH_PATH = globals().get("MH_PATH", globals().get("MH_DIR"))   # Delta table with Move History (loads + yard moves, already deduplicated)

# ---------- Move History: Delta table ----------
mh_raw = spark.read.format("delta").load(MH_PATH)
print("Delta columns:", mh_raw.columns)

norm = lambda s: re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", s.lower())
WANT = {"Time_Completed": ["timecompleted", "timeofevent"],
        "Event_ID":       ["eventid", "event", "eventtype"],
        "Move_Kind":      ["movekind"],
        "Unit_Category":  ["unitcategory", "categoryid", "category"],
        "Unit_Nbr":       ["unitnbr", "containernbr", "unitid"],
        "From_Position":  ["fromposition", "fromposname"],
        "To_Position":    ["toposition", "toposname"],
        "Unit_Frght_Kind":["unitfrghtkind", "freightkindid", "freightkind", "status"],
        "Dist_Carry":     ["distcarry"]}

by_norm = {norm(c): c for c in mh_raw.columns}
pick = {}
for target, aliases in WANT.items():
    hit = next((by_norm[a] for a in aliases if a in by_norm), None)
    if hit: pick[target] = hit
missing = [c for c in WANT if c != "Dist_Carry" and c not in pick]
assert not missing, f"Move History table has no column for: {missing}. Columns found: {mh_raw.columns}"
print("Column mapping:", {k: v for k, v in pick.items() if k != v} or "names already match")

extra = ["source_file"] if "source_file" in mh_raw.columns else []
mh = mh_raw.select(*[F.col(v).alias(k) for k, v in pick.items()], *extra).toPandas()
if "source_file" not in mh: mh["source_file"] = "delta"

# timestamps: keep real timestamps; parse text safely
if not pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(mh.Time_Completed):
    s = mh.Time_Completed.astype(str).str.strip()
    iso = s.str.match(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}").mean() > 0.5
    mh["Time_Completed"] = pd.to_datetime(s, errors="coerce", dayfirst=not iso)
mh["Time_Completed"] = mh.Time_Completed.astype("datetime64[ns]")

for c in ["Event_ID", "Move_Kind", "Unit_Category", "Unit_Frght_Kind",
          "Unit_Nbr", "From_Position", "To_Position"]:
    mh[c] = mh[c].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
if "Dist_Carry" in mh:
    mh["Dist_Carry"] = pd.to_numeric(mh.Dist_Carry, errors="coerce")

print(f"Move History: {len(mh):,} rows (no further dedup, table is already clean)")
print("Rows per source_file:\n" + mh.source_file.value_counts().sort_index().to_string())

# ---------- N4 position corrections ----------
pc_raw = spark.read.format("delta").load(PC_PATH)
pc = pc_raw.select(*[F.col(v).alias(k) for k, v in PC.items()]).toPandas()
pc["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(pc["ts"], errors="coerce")
for c in ["unit", "event", "frm", "to", "status"]:
    pc[c] = pc[c].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
print(f"Corrections table: {len(pc):,} rows")

REQ = ["Time_Completed", "Event_ID", "Move_Kind", "Unit_Category",
       "Unit_Nbr", "From_Position", "To_Position", "Unit_Frght_Kind"]

print("1) Required Move History columns")
miss_all = [c for c in REQ if c not in mh.columns]
print("   missing in all files:", miss_all or "none")
if not miss_all:
    for fname, d in mh.groupby("source_file"):
        print(f"   {fname}: missing:", [c for c in REQ if d[c].isna().all() or (d[c] == "").all()] or "none")

print("\n2) Value mix – Move History")
print(mh.groupby(["Event_ID", "Move_Kind", "Unit_Category", "Unit_Frght_Kind"]).size().to_string())
print("\n   Value mix – corrections")
print(pc.groupby(["event", "status"]).size().to_string())

print("\n3) Unparsed timestamps:  MH", int(mh.Time_Completed.isna().sum()), "| corrections", int(pc.ts.isna().sum()))

ym_all = mh[mh.Event_ID == YARD_EVENT]
ld_all = mh[mh.Event_ID == LOAD_EVENT]
pcc    = pc[pc.event == CORR_EVENT]
print("\n4) From-positions that are standard slots")
print(f"   MH yard moves: {ym_all.From_Position.str.match(STD).mean():.1%}")
print(f"   MH loads     : {ld_all.From_Position.str.match(STD).mean():.1%}")
print(f"   corrections  : {pcc.frm.str.match(STD).mean():.1%}")

print("\n5) Time alignment between sources (hours, rounded; most should be 0)")
def align(a, b, on):
    p = a.merge(b, on=on)
    p["diff_h"] = (p.t_pc - p.t_mh).dt.total_seconds() / 3600
    p = p[p.diff_h.abs() <= 12]
    return len(p), p.diff_h.round().value_counts().head(3).to_dict()
a = ym_all[["Unit_Nbr", "From_Position", "Time_Completed"]].set_axis(["unit", "frm", "t_mh"], axis=1)
b = pcc[["unit", "frm", "ts"]].rename(columns={"ts": "t_pc"})
print("   yard move vs correction (same unit + from):", align(a, b, ["unit", "frm"]))
lb = pc[pc.event == LOAD_EVENT][["unit", "ts"]].rename(columns={"ts": "t_pc"})
if len(lb):
    la = ld_all[["Unit_Nbr", "Time_Completed"]].set_axis(["unit", "t_mh"], axis=1)
    print("   load vs load (same unit):", align(la, lb, ["unit"]))

print("\n6) Daily coverage (export FCL)")
exp_fcl = mh.Unit_Category.isin(EXPORT_VALS) & (mh.Unit_Frght_Kind == FCL_MH)
day = lambda s: s.dt.date
cov = pd.DataFrame({
    "mh_first":  mh.groupby(day(mh.Time_Completed)).Time_Completed.min().dt.strftime("%H:%M"),
    "mh_last":   mh.groupby(day(mh.Time_Completed)).Time_Completed.max().dt.strftime("%H:%M"),
    "mh_yard":   mh[exp_fcl & (mh.Event_ID == YARD_EVENT)].groupby(day(mh.Time_Completed)).size(),
    "mh_loads":  mh[exp_fcl & (mh.Event_ID == LOAD_EVENT)].groupby(day(mh.Time_Completed)).size(),
    "pc_corr":   pcc[pcc.status == FCL_PC].groupby(day(pcc.ts)).size(),
    "pc_first":  pcc.groupby(day(pcc.ts)).ts.min().dt.strftime("%H:%M"),
    "pc_last":   pcc.groupby(day(pcc.ts)).ts.max().dt.strftime("%H:%M"),
})
cov["corr_per_100_loads"] = (100 * cov.pc_corr / cov.mh_loads).round(0)
print(cov.to_string())
print(f"\n   Overall corrections per 100 loads: {100 * cov.pc_corr.sum() / cov.mh_loads.sum():.0f}  (spec: 40–180 full extract, ~7 = daily report only)")

def keep(d, mask, label):
    out = d[mask]
    print(f"   {label:<30}{len(out):>9,}   (-{len(d) - len(out):,})")
    return out

mhx = mh[mh.Unit_Category.isin(EXPORT_VALS) & (mh.Unit_Frght_Kind == FCL_MH)]
pcf = pc[pc.status == FCL_PC]
ren = {"Unit_Nbr": "unit", "From_Position": "frm", "To_Position": "to", "Time_Completed": "ts"}

# ---------- Step 1: moves ----------
ym = mhx[(mhx.Event_ID == YARD_EVENT) & mhx.Move_Kind.isin(YARD_MOVE_KINDS)].rename(columns=ren)
cols = ["unit", "frm", "to", "ts"]
moves = pd.concat([ym[cols].assign(src="MH yard move"),
                   pcf[pcf.event == CORR_EVENT][cols].assign(src="N4 correction")], ignore_index=True)
print("Step 1 – move set");  print("   raw:", len(moves), moves.src.value_counts().to_dict())
moves = keep(moves, moves.ts.notna(),                  "has a timestamp")
moves = keep(moves, moves.frm.str.match(STD),          "from = standard slot")
moves = keep(moves, moves.to.str.startswith("Y-PEB-"), "to = yard position")
moves = keep(moves, ~is_prestage(moves.frm),           "from not rail pre-staging")
moves = moves.sort_values(["unit", "ts"], kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)
dup = (moves.unit.eq(moves.unit.shift()) & moves.frm.eq(moves.frm.shift())
       & (moves.ts - moves.ts.shift()).abs().le(DEDUP_MOVE))
moves = keep(moves, ~dup,                                         "10-min duplicates removed")
moves = keep(moves, moves.frm.str[6:13] != moves.to.str[6:13],    "tier-only dropped").reset_index(drop=True)
moves["block"] = moves.frm.str[6:10]
moves["row"]   = moves.frm.str[10:12].astype(int)
moves["stack"] = moves.frm.str[12]
moves["ts"]    = moves.ts.astype("datetime64[ns]")
print("   by source:", moves.src.value_counts().to_dict())

# ---------- Step 2: loads ----------
ldm = mhx[(mhx.Event_ID == LOAD_EVENT) & mhx.Move_Kind.isin(LOAD_MOVE_KINDS)].rename(columns=ren)
lc = ["unit", "frm", "ts"]
loads = pd.concat([ldm[lc].assign(src="MH load"),
                   pcf[pcf.event == LOAD_EVENT][lc].assign(src="N4 load")], ignore_index=True)
print("\nStep 2 – load set");  print("   raw:", len(loads), loads.src.value_counts().to_dict())
loads = keep(loads, loads.ts.notna(),         "has a timestamp")
loads = keep(loads, loads.frm.str.match(STD), "from = standard slot")
loads = loads.rename(columns={"unit": "load_unit", "frm": "lfrm", "ts": "tf"})
loads = loads.sort_values(["load_unit", "tf"], kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)
ldup = loads.load_unit.eq(loads.load_unit.shift()) & (loads.tf - loads.tf.shift()).abs().le(DEDUP_LOAD)
loads = keep(loads, ~ldup, "2-h duplicates removed").reset_index(drop=True)
loads["block"] = loads.lfrm.str[6:10]
loads["row"]   = loads.lfrm.str[10:12].astype(int)
loads["stack"] = loads.lfrm.str[12]
loads["tf"]    = loads.tf.astype("datetime64[ns]")

# Rule A – rehandle: first load after the move, same block + stack, row -1/0/+1, within 2 h, different unit
moves["rehandle"] = False
ls = loads.sort_values("tf")[["block", "stack", "row", "tf", "load_unit"]]
for off in (-1, 0, 1):
    m = (moves[["unit", "block", "stack", "row", "ts"]]
         .assign(row=moves.row + off).reset_index().sort_values("ts"))     # 'index' = original move id
    j = pd.merge_asof(m, ls, left_on="ts", right_on="tf", by=["block", "stack", "row"],
                      direction="forward", tolerance=LOAD_WINDOW)
    hit = j.tf.notna() & (j.load_unit != j.unit)
    moves.loc[j.loc[hit, "index"], "rehandle"] = True

# Rule B – housekeeping: not a rehandle and the box changed row or block
same_block = moves.frm.str[6:10] == moves.to.str[6:10]
moves["housekeeping"] = ~moves.rehandle & (moves.frm.str[6:12] != moves.to.str[6:12])
moves["hk_rr"] = moves.housekeeping & same_block
moves["hk_bb"] = moves.housekeeping & ~same_block

# Rule C – excluded: same-row shuffle with no load after it
moves["excluded"] = ~moves.rehandle & ~moves.housekeeping

# open decision in the spec: adjacent-row, no-stack corrections (flagged, not removed)
to_row = pd.to_numeric(moves.to.str[10:12], errors="coerce")
moves["hk_adjacent_nostack"] = (moves.housekeeping & ~moves.to.str.match(STD) & same_block
                                & (to_row - moves.row).abs().eq(1))

moves["class"] = "Excluded (same row)"
moves.loc[moves.hk_rr, "class"] = "Housekeeping row-to-row"
moves.loc[moves.hk_bb, "class"] = "Housekeeping block-to-block"
moves.loc[moves.rehandle, "class"] = "Rehandle"
print(pd.crosstab(moves["class"], moves.src, margins=True).to_string())

mv = moves[~moves.ts.dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d").isin(EXCLUDE_DAYS)].copy()
ld = loads[~loads.tf.dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d").isin(EXCLUDE_DAYS)].copy()
mv["date"], ld["date"] = mv.ts.dt.normalize(), ld.tf.dt.normalize()
mv["wk"] = (mv.date - GO_LIVE).dt.days // 7          # 0 = W0 (28 Sep), negative = before go-live
ld["wk"] = (ld.date - GO_LIVE).dt.days // 7

CNT = ["loads", "rehandles", "housekeeping", "hk_row_to_row", "hk_block_to_block",
       "hk_adjacent_nostack", "excluded_same_row", "moves", "days_with_data"]

def rollup(key):
    g = mv.groupby(key)
    t = pd.DataFrame({
        "moves": g.size(), "rehandles": g.rehandle.sum(), "housekeeping": g.housekeeping.sum(),
        "hk_row_to_row": g.hk_rr.sum(), "hk_block_to_block": g.hk_bb.sum(),
        "hk_adjacent_nostack": g.hk_adjacent_nostack.sum(), "excluded_same_row": g.excluded.sum(),
        "days_with_data": g.date.nunique()})
    t = t.join(ld.groupby(key).size().rename("loads"), how="outer").fillna(0)[CNT].astype(int)
    dd = t.days_with_data.where(t.days_with_data > 0)
    t["rehandles_per_100_loads"]  = (100 * t.rehandles / t.loads.where(t.loads > 0)).round(1)
    t["housekeeping_per_day"]     = (t.housekeeping / dd).round(1)
    t["hk_per_day_excl_adjacent"] = ((t.housekeeping - t.hk_adjacent_nostack) / dd).round(1)
    return t.reset_index()

weekly, daily = rollup("wk"), rollup("date")
daily["wk"] = (daily.date - GO_LIVE).dt.days // 7
for t in (weekly, daily):
    ws  = GO_LIVE + pd.to_timedelta(t.wk * 7, unit="D")
    iso = ws.dt.isocalendar()
    t["week_start"]   = ws.dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    t["iso_week"]     = iso.year.astype(str) + "-W" + iso.week.astype(str).str.zfill(2)
    t["go_live_week"] = t.wk.map(lambda n: "W0" if n == 0 else f"W{n:+d}")
weekly["reportable"] = weekly.loads >= MIN_LOADS_WEEK
daily["date"] = daily.date.dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

lead = ["week_start", "iso_week", "go_live_week"]
weekly = weekly[lead + ["reportable"] + [c for c in weekly.columns if c not in lead + ["wk", "reportable"]]]
daily  = daily[["date"] + lead + [c for c in daily.columns if c not in lead + ["date", "wk"]]]

# "before go-live" = plain average of weekly values W-8 … W-2 (reportable weeks only)
pre = weekly[weekly.go_live_week.isin([f"W-{n}" for n in range(2, 9)]) & weekly.reportable]
if len(pre):
    print(f"Before go-live ({len(pre)} weeks): rehandles/100 loads = {pre.rehandles_per_100_loads.mean():.1f}, "
          f"housekeeping/day = {pre.housekeeping_per_day.mean():.0f}")
print("Excluded days:", EXCLUDE_DAYS or "none")

# exports: full tables, not limited by display()
mssparkutils.fs.mkdirs(OUT)
mssparkutils.fs.put(OUT + "rehandle_hk_weekly.csv", weekly.to_csv(index=False), True)
mssparkutils.fs.put(OUT + "rehandle_hk_daily.csv",  daily.to_csv(index=False),  True)
(spark.createDataFrame(moves).write.mode("overwrite").option("overwriteSchema", "true")
      .format("delta").save(OUT + "delta/rehandle_hk_moves"))
print(f"Saved: weekly {len(weekly)} rows, daily {len(daily)} rows, classified moves {len(moves):,} rows")

display(spark.createDataFrame(weekly))
